clip.prompt:
Vertical 9:16 UGC-style fashion try-on video for social media, 15 seconds, four quick cuts, natural phone-camera look, bright warm apartment with wood floors, an arched mirror and soft daylight. The presenter is an AI-generated young adult woman (not any real person), friendly and excited, speaking English directly to the camera. Clear natural speech, light room tone, no background music, no on-screen text, no logos.
The dress in every shot is the exact burgundy chunky rib-knit turtleneck sweater dress from the reference images: loose slouchy fit, folded turtleneck, dropped shoulders, long full sleeves with ribbed cuffs, ribbed hem, mini length ending at mid-thigh. Keep its color, chunky rib knit, turtleneck and length identical to the references.
Shot 1 (0-3 s): wearing a casual white tee, she holds the burgundy sweater dress on a hanger up to the camera, saying: "Okay, this sweater dress is so cozy."
Shot 2 (3-7 s): cut to her wearing it, mid-shot, folding the turtleneck down and pushing up the slouchy sleeves, saying: "It's a slouchy turtleneck with dropped shoulders."
Shot 3 (7-11 s): cut to a full-length shot wearing it with opaque black tights and black knee-high boots; she does a little twirl, saying: "Throw it on with tights and boots and you're done."
Shot 4 (11-15 s): she walks up to the camera into a smiling close-up, saying: "Seven colors, sizes small to 3X. Link's right here."
